ink.name: Ink & Ember
ink.desc: Words appear as they are sung while a glowing pen draws a brush line under them.

kinetic.name: Kinetic Slam
kinetic.desc: One huge word at a time, slamming in on the beat with camera shake.

neon.name: Neon Night
neon.desc: Glowing neon tube lettering that flickers on, over a pulsing synthwave grid.

karaoke.name: Clean Karaoke
karaoke.desc: The full line on screen, filling with colour word by word; next line below.

typewriter.name: Typewriter
typewriter.desc: Letters are typed out on paper with a blinking cursor; the page scrolls.

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.desc: Elegant serif lines that resolve out of blur, letterbox bars and light leaks.

social.name: Social Captions
social.desc: Bold short phrases with the active word on a colour block. Made for Reels and Shorts.
